listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Guide a Visitor
listening.transcript: The old station was built in 1910 and is now used as a community centre. A volunteer who grew up nearby leads a free tour at eleven. Bring a light jacket because part of the tour is outside.

options: A volunteer who grew up nearby
questions.answer: A volunteer who grew up nearby

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the heritage centre to confirm your booking. We’re holding the culture tour on Sunday. It starts at 9 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the heritage centre! Are you here for the culture tour? Please meet us in the Blue Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 9 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the culture tour. It lasts 45 minutes. A ticket costs 3 pounds. We have space for 10 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the culture tour at the heritage centre. There are 10 places. Use the north entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Nina. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

reading.text: On Saturdays, the centre hosts a repair café at two. The café is a place where visitors bring small broken items. Repairs are free, but a donation is welcome.

questions.q: What should visitors bring if they want help?

passages.title: Online booking page
passages.text: Culture tour bookings close at 12:00. Reserve your place online before that time. Look for a confirmation in your email inbox.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?

passages.title: Ticket collection sign
passages.text: Ticket collection: show your confirmation at the heritage centre information desk. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

questions.q: Where do you collect your ticket?

passages.title: Payment instructions
passages.text: Pay by card when you book the culture tour. Keep the confirmation email until the event is over.

passages.title: Message for participants
passages.text: Plans changed? You can move your booking free of charge until Wednesday. If you arrive late, please wait at the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.
